claude.sample_unit: LLM responses to bariatric surgery questions

links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy of LLM bariatric surgery answers against clinical reference standards
links.effect: Consensus 'good' ratings: ChatGPT-4 90.0%, ERNIE Bot 4.0 84.0%, Claude 3 Opus 80%, Gemini Pro 48.0%; poor ratings 0-14%; inter-rater kappa 0.210 for accuracy.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4 received “good” ratings for 90.0% of its responses, which were significantly higher than those of ERNIE Bot 4.0 (84.0%), Claude 3 Opus (80%), and Gemini Pro (48.0%; all p ≤ 0.05).

links.outcome: Comprehensiveness and completeness of LLM clinical answers on bariatric surgery
links.effect: All LLMs sub-optimal in comprehensiveness: Claude 3 Opus 3.13, Gemini Pro 3.06, ERNIE 2.91, ChatGPT-4 2.86 out of 5.
links.quote: All four LLMs performed sub-optimally, but Claude 3 Opus (3.13 ± 0.46) and Gemini Pro (3.06 ± 0.44) outperformed ChatGPT 4.0 (2.86 ± 0.41) and ERNIE Bot 4.0 (2.91 ± 0.48).

links.outcome: Whether LLMs flag uncertainty when responses remain incorrect after self-correction
links.effect: Authors note absence of automated disclaimers and that chatbots may propagate erroneous information without disclosing uncertainty; some responses stayed poor after self-correction.
links.quote: this suggests that, even with self-correction mechanisms, LLM chatbots may still propagate erroneous medical information without disclosing the uncertainty of their outputs 14 .

links.outcome: Quality of sources cited by LLMs when web search and evidence-based prompts were used
links.effect: Cited resources predominantly came from open medical websites lacking explicit EBM methodologies.
links.quote: Our study revealed that the resources cited by the evaluated LLMs predominantly came from open medical websites lacking explicit EBM methodologies, raising concerns about their understanding of EBM principles (Supplementary Tables 6 a-c), highlighting limitations in integrating high-quality evidence.

links.outcome: Change in accuracy of poorly rated responses after re-prompting (self-correction), small samples
links.effect: Basic self-correction improved ERNIE and Claude 2/2 (100%), Gemini 6/7 (85.71%); web-enabled correction gave mixed results, with Gemini's four responses staying poor.
links.quote: ERNIE Bot 4.0 and Claude 3 Opus achieved a perfect 100% improvement rate (2 of 2 responses), while Gemini Pro showed an improvement rate of 85.71% (6 of 7 responses).

unlisted_practices: Multidisciplinary expert panel evaluation of LLM output
LLM self-correction via re-prompting and web-enabled review

openai.sample_unit: LLM responses to 50 bariatric surgery questions

links.effect: Good ratings differed: ChatGPT-4 90.0%, ERNIE Bot 84.0%, Claude 80%, Gemini Pro 48.0%; all p≤0.05.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4 received “good” ratings for 90.0% of its responses, which were significantly higher than those of ERNIE Bot 4.0 (84.0%), Claude 3 Opus (80%), and Gemini Pro (48.0%; all p ≤ 0.05).

links.effect: Accuracy rates varied 48.0%~90.0%; comprehensiveness scores ranged 2.86 ± 0.41 ~ 3.13 ± 0.46.
links.quote: The evaluated LLMs showed variability in accuracy and fell short of ideal comprehensiveness scores.

links.effect: Good ratings: Gemini Pro 44%, ChatGPT 4.0 83%, ERNIE 78%, Claude 72%; Χ²=10.987, p≥0.05.
links.quote: In the ‘recovery, risks, and complications’ domain, all LLMs performed worse, with Gemini Pro achieving only a 44% “good” rating, lower than ChatGPT 4.0 (83%), ERNIE Bot 4.0 (78%), and Claude 3 Opus (72%; Χ²=10.987, p ≥ 0.05).

links.effect: Internet/evidence prompts: Claude improved 4/4; ERNIE had 3 Good and 1 Borderline; Gemini retained Poor in 4/14 responses.
links.quote: The results indicate that mere access to internet resources does not guarantee improved performance 41 [, 42 .

links.effect: Fleiss’ kappa: accuracy 0.210 (95% CI 0.208–0.212); comprehensiveness 0.464 (95% CI 0.453–0.476).
links.quote: The inter‑rater agreement was as follows: accuracy rating, Fleiss’ kappa = 0.210 (95% CI: 0.208–0.212; Z = 7.815; P < 0.001); comprehensiveness rating, Fleiss’ kappa = 0.464 (95% CI: 0.453–0.476; Z = 2.543; P < 0.011).

unlisted_practices: Prompt-based self-correction of poor medical LLM answers after a user challenge.

links.outcome: accuracy after web-enabled and evidence-based review
links.effect: ERNIE Bot 4.0 achieved 3 Good and 1 Borderline rating, Claude 3 Opus achieved 100% improvement (4 of 4), while Gemini Pro retained poor ratings in 4 of 14 responses
links.quote: When prompted to use Internet searches and evidence-based resources, ERNIE Bot 4.0 achieved three “Good” and one “Borderline” rating, while Claude 3 Opus maintained a perfect 100% improvement rate (4 of 4 responses).
